title: Global search lists an inactive part with a grey Inactive tag
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Setting: the organization uses the new global search (the top-bar Search shows results grouped by record type, with badges). The old search cannot run this case.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part set inactive in Setup; [Part-B] = tracked part, active; both at [Loc-1], numbers sharing the start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-0.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL GSTAG B).
  5. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: typing ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-02 in the top-bar Search lists [Part-B] in grouped results. If the search shows the old flat list, mark the case Blocked with 'new global search not on'.
custom_steps:
1. Click "Search" in the top bar (or press Ctrl+K).
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GSTAG-0".
  3. Read the parts results.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Both [Part-A] and [Part-B] are listed. [Part-A] carries a grey "Inactive" tag; [Part-B] has no tag.
